tickets.name: Tip-Off Call
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Wizards at Thunder, because the first minute is where the money is! Davis and Hartenstein meet in the circle, and Davis has been winning these jumps all season long! Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Wizards! Dybantsa is the first option in that opening set, and he does not pass it up! One man, one bet: Dybantsa. Let's ride!

tickets.name: Get on the Board
tickets.note: Knicks visiting Cavaliers, and we've got the opening possessions mapped out! Mobley versus Towns for the tip, and Mobley has owned that matchup in the circle! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Cavaliers to cash the first trip! Watson gets the first touch for the Cavaliers, and he's hunting his shot! Only one man in this game beats his price, and it's Watson. Let's go!

tickets.name: First Look
tickets.note: It's Magic and Warriors, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! The jump ball goes Carter against Green, and Carter has the springs tonight! That puts the Magic on the front foot to get on the board first. Richardson slips free on the opening set, and that's our man! Just one play in this game, and it's Richardson all the way!

tickets.name: Set Play
tickets.note: Spurs at Trail Blazers. Grab a seat, the first bucket is a story we've already read! It starts with Wembanyama against Clingan at center court, and our money says Wembanyama gets up there first! That hands the Spurs the first possession, and that's half the battle! When the Spurs come down for the first time, Castle is the one we're watching! Should the Trail Blazers grab the first possession, Clingan is our trigger man! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!
